name: Arikawa Ren
source:
Unidentified beautiful girl (?) character

He is one year younger than Yuuichi and is also a distant relative.
He looks like a girl, but she is a proper boy, with a calm personality, homely and single-minded.
His family runs a game shop where Yuuichi and Shou go to.

[From Pikopiko's official website]
